subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical core investigation for the four-Telegram-agent simultaneous LLM timeout bottleneck, or should it be narrowed to the already-merged fallback-abort mitigation work?
rationale: Current source and merged PRs show partial timeout-cascade mitigations, but choosing between Telegram concurrency, provider transport, launchd/threadpool defaults, and new config surfaces requires maintainer product and owner-boundary judgment after live evidence.

options.title: Keep Core Investigation
options.body: Leave this issue open for a live current-main trace and a focused core fix once the actual bottleneck is identified.

options.title: Narrow To Fallback Mitigation
options.body: Treat the remaining work as covered by merged fallback-abort fixes and require a new issue for any fresh live repro.

options.title: Split By Surface
options.body: Create separate maintainer-owned follow-ups for Telegram sink concurrency, provider transport DNS/family policy, and service environment defaults.

recommendation.title: Keep Core Investigation
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open for a live current-main trace and a focused core fix once the actual bottleneck is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest recent routing candidate because they authored the linked fallback mitigation and already scoped it as partial in the issue discussion.
